obligations.definition: The complete native ALUExeUnit interface has no parameters or functional storage. Outputs react combinationally to current inputs; compare after propagation has settled. clock only checks legality on its rising edge. reset disables those legality checks but does not reset, clear or gate functional outputs. All described outputs remain defined for legal two-state inputs, including when corresponding valid is low. Numerical results with X/Z inputs are unspecified. Let G mean io_req_valid and bit 2 of io_req_bits_uop_fu_code. When reset is low at a rising edge, G and ctrl_is_std require rs2_data[64]=0 and fp_val=0; G and fp_val require uopc=1 or 2.

Compare the applicable outputs using four-state !== against the same input-only dvbench_model; fail on any mismatch or if no relevant comparison occurs. No fixed period, delay, edge-relative combinational sample, or total count is required.

coverage_policy: The fixed R obligations and five-dimensional denominator remain unchanged. All tests may be combined; stimulus cannot be supplied by inference from expected/given feature/names. Basic legal observable cases earn partial-domain credit; full credit requires satisfying both the complete domain and the boundaries. A locally invalid checker does not remove independent checker support already provided by other tests.

R-dv-003-001.description: Use a legal preparation for the stateless combinational interface. Drive legal two-state inputs for functional behavior; when checking rising-edge legality rules, meet those rules at the relevant rising edge. No particular time-zero values, clock period, or drive edge is required. Randomize each input over its full declared two-state width; whenever G is true, force rs2_data[64]=0 and fp_val=0 for ctrl_is_std, and restrict fp_val=1 to uopc=1 or 2. Toggle reset and all native inputs, exercise active and inactive G, and preserve asserted legal constraints at each rising edge.

Drive legal two-state inputs for functional behavior; when checking rising-edge legality rules, meet those rules at the relevant rising edge. Randomize every native uop field; sweep valid/FU bit2 and branch masks including overlapping resolve/mispredict bits, empty masks, and highest bit.

sampling_policy: Assess observable behavior and effective observation windows, not a fixed clock period, time-zero input assignment, fixed nanosecond delay, or a prescribed observation count. Combinational behavior is checked after propagation and settling; clocked legality conditions are checked at the specified rising edge.
